components.name: Primary Button (Public)
components.description: Gold pill CTA used across SiteHeader, landing, academia, reservar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d8b32d; color: #0a3d7d; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d0a92a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a3d7d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Admin)
components.description: Solid navy action button used across admin forms and print actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-admin-primary { background: #00205B; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-admin-primary:hover { background: rgba(0,32,91,0.8); } .ds-btn-admin-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-admin-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00205B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button (Admin)
components.description: Outline gray button, the most-repeated admin button pattern (modal Cancelar, filter bars).
components.css: .ds-btn-admin-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #4b5563; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-admin-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; }

components.name: Destructive Button (Admin)
components.description: Solid red action button, canonical example is academia's Desactivar.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.description: EstadoTorneoBadge pattern, one color pair per state; this example shows the 'En curso' (blue) state.

narrative.overview: Pro Futbol Antigua runs on home-turf confidence: navy structure, gold accents, the visual language of an established club that has been here a while and is proud of it. But the gate stays open — gold isn't just a CTA color, it's a welcome, and the softer shadows and generous rounded corners on the public pages exist so a family booking its first court feels invited in, not processed. That confidence-plus-invitation idea only governs the public, Persuade-mode surfaces (home, landing, academia, reservar's booking flow, the shared SiteHeader). The admin panel and the superadmin diagnostics panel are Operate-mode work surfaces — staff running caja, academia, torneos, reportes all day — and ambition there shows as precision and restraint, not narrative. This file documents three zones, not one undifferentiated palette, because that is what is actually shipped.
keyCharacteristics: Two navies in active use, each scoped to its zone, never interchanged (see 'The Zone Rule' below).
Two reds in active use, same zone-scoping logic.
Elevation is a deliberate split: flat in Operate, soft-shadowed in Persuade — not an inconsistency to unify.
Icons are a deliberate split: Phosphor Icons in Admin/Superadmin, hand-written inline SVG in Public — not an inconsistency to unify.
Geist (Sans + Mono) is the only type family anywhere in the app.

rules.name: The Zone Rule
rules.body: navy and brand-navy are not interchangeable, and neither are red and action-red. Operate surfaces (admin, superadmin-adjacent utility pages) never use brand-navy; Persuade surfaces (home, landing, academia, SiteHeader) never use the stock navy token. Adding a UI element to a zone means reaching for that zone's color, not whichever navy looks closest.

rules.name: The Flat-Operate Rule
rules.body: Nothing in app/admin/** or app/superadmin/** gets a custom shadow or a bracket-value radius. If it needs to pop, reach for shadow-lg/shadow-xl, not a bespoke value — Operate's restraint is the brand signal there, not decoration.

dos: Do use navy/action-red on Operate surfaces (admin, superadmin-adjacent public utility pages) and brand-navy/red on Persuade surfaces (home, landing, academia, SiteHeader) — per the Zone Rule.
Do use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) in admin/superadmin and hand-written inline SVG in public pages — this split is deliberate.
Do use rounded-full for any new status/pill badge, matching EstadoTorneoBadge.
Do give new admin inputs a focus:ring-2 focus:ring-navy treatment, matching the login page rather than the browser default most admin forms currently fall back to.
donts: Don't invent a fourth navy or a third red. If an existing token doesn't fit, that's a signal to ask, not to pick a new arbitrary hex.
Don't add a custom shadow or bracket-value radius inside app/admin/** or app/superadmin/** — the Flat-Operate Rule holds there.
Don't apply navy/brand-navy/gold tokens to the superadmin panel — its dark slate/amber theme is intentionally its own system.
Don't promote reservar's chat-widget blues to a global token without an explicit decision to do so.
